(2) The scene cuts to the man holding a smartphone in a modern home setting with a large green plant in the background. He displays an app called 'Speak' on the screen, which shows progress bars and a calendar. He points at the screen while looking at the camera. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review for the 'Speak' AI English learning app. The creator uses his personal challenge of conducting an all-English interview to justify the need for language practice, demonstrates the app's convenience and AI feedback features in various daily scenarios, and concludes with a strong commercial call-to-action featuring discounts and partner rewards.
